title: Any future P2 witness h must be a GLOBAL self-embedding (preserve+reflect ALL relations, incl. cross-gadget coupling edges)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Standing proof obligation for the (P2) embedding criterion: the witness $h$ must be a GLOBAL self-embedding of $\B$, not of a truncated substructure.**

The draft correctly retracts (Remarks `rem:K4-honest`, `rem:diagnosis`) the earlier fatal error: the local reflection $\rho$ of Prop. `prop:K3` is an automorphism only of the *induced substructure* $\bar c\cup G_{n_0}$ (with the spine edges incident to $G_{n_0}$ deleted), not of $\A$. Existential formulas are preserved under embeddings $\bar c\cup G_{n_0}\hookrightarrow\A$, **not** under a merely partial map.

This pins down the exact obligation any **future** (P2) proof via Lemma `lem:embcrit` must discharge, and it is a recurring trap:

> For each finite $\bar a$, exhibit a map $h:\B\to\B$ that is
> (a) **injective**, and
> (b) preserves AND reflects **every** relation of $\B$ **globally** (a self-embedding of all of $\B$), and
> (c) fixes $\bar a\cup\pi(\bar a)$ pointwise, and
> (d) satisfies $h(\pi(x_0))\neq\pi(h(x_0))$ for some $x_0$.

Condition (b) is where the previous construction collapsed: any coupling relation (the analogue of the spine $R$) incident to the gadget being reflected must **also** be preserved by $h$. With a *directed, position-aligned* spine this is impossible (reflecting one gadget breaks the directed rungs) — which is exactly why `def:A` admits no such global $h$ and fails (P2).

**Design consequence (constraint on the YES branch, issue prob-01-9).** The coupling relations of any successful $\B$ must be invariant under the local reflections used to build $h$. Concretely:
- either the coupling is **undirected** and **symmetric** under per-gadget reflection (so reflecting a gadget is a global self-embedding), or
- the coupling lives on data (gadget indices / a parity class) that the reflection fixes setwise while the orientation it flips is *not* tied to any directed relation an $\exists$-witness can traverse.

**Verification checklist for any submitted $h$:** for every relation symbol $S$ and every tuple $\bar t$ over $\B$, check $S^{\B}(\bar t)\iff S^{\B}(h\bar t)$ — including tuples with one foot inside and one foot outside the reflected gadget (these cross-edges are what killed `def:A`; numerically, on a finite model the analogous $\rho$ broke dozens of $R$-edges between adjacent gadgets). A self-embedding that only checks intra-gadget relations is invalid.
